svg.title: zkLTC in the V2 architecture
svg.desc: Native LTC on Litecoin, represented through the Charms integration as zkLTC on Ethereum. Arbitrum infrastructure connects Ethereum and LitVM, where zkLTC is intended for gas and applications. Testnet tokens are separate from native LTC.

g.aria-label: One underlying asset · distinct network roles
Intended native gas and application asset
Testnet tokens are separate from native LTC.
